gaps.what: The 970 doubling of the shape (62k to 135k km2, the whole northern highland to 23.3 N) and boundary noise at 1056 and 1188-1385 are unverified (page budget); the 1363 loss of the western uplands to Lan Xang is dated only by Cliopatria (confidence 1, page silent)

Suzerainty over Đại Việt (Song tribute from 972, Annan duhu 986, King of Nam Bình after 1077; Yuan from 1258/1288; Ming 1407) and the mirror of the 1075-1082 Song-Đại Việt exchange are not in this ledger and must be carried by northern-song, yuan-dynasty and ming-dynasty

The pages describe a speculated mandala whose vassalage fell apart after 1298, yet Cliopatria draws 395,000 km2 to 1362; the shapes 1241-1362 are kept (ok, soft) with tributary tints at confidence 1; a better source is needed for Sukhothai's real extent
The 1550-1552 Mon revival (Hanthawaddy page: briefly revived in 1550, defeated in March 1552) is not drawn; its extent is not on the pages opened
Pegu and the delta joined Wareru's Martaban kingdom at an undated point (bridged to 1294 at confidence 1); the pagan-kingdom dossier records the loss of all Lower Burma in 1287

Same state as Cliopatria's 'Lan Na' row (1600-1761, slug lan-na, another part): not merged because the brief forbids editing that dossier; Tilokaraj's undated conquest of Phrae and Nan and his westward Shan vassals are not drawn

The 672-cell shape includes 193 Shan-hill cells that the page gives to the Shan states; the 1303 gain names the Yuan as counterpart without the page saying who held the granaries; capital coordinates unsourced
The page's extent (the whole Yonok basin) is much larger than Cliopatria's 18 cells and is not drawn; founding date is a range (1037-1131), 1094 from the Ngoenyang infobox
Two sentences from two pages: no leader, seat or boundary

problems: lan-na-kingdom and Cliopatria's 'Lan Na' (slug lan-na, owned by another part) are one state (Q1059707, one article, infobox 1296-1775): I wrote lan-na-kingdom 1292-1558 only and named lan-na as successor; the orchestrator should merge the two dossiers under lan-na-kingdom (cliopatria_names both) or make lan-na its continuation with the same colour.

Myinsaing (1297-1313) and Cliopatria's Pinya (1314-) are the same 672 cells, one polity and dynasty under a new capital; kept apart because Cliopatria and the infobox list Pinya as successor; a merge under myinsaing-kingdom is possible.
ngo-dynasty is one state under six dynasties (Ngô to Hồ), displayed as 'Đại Việt (Ngô to Hồ dynasties)'; its end is 1407 (page) against Cliopatria's 1406, and its start 939 against 947.
hanthawaddy-kingdom starts 30 January 1287 and ends May 1541 (Cliopatria 1294..1546).

Page budget: ngo-dynasty used ten pages (budget nine; the tenth, Khmer-Cham wars, matches khmer-empire's 1132-1136 contest); lan-na-kingdom used six plus the shared Lan Xang and Ngoenyang pages (budget five; one page, Burmese-Siamese War 1547-1549, was opened in error and is silent). No page gave an infobox area for any of the six states.

Counterpart events that other dossiers must carry: pagan-kingdom (loss of Pegu and the delta in 1294, Tenasserim 1294), first-toungoo-empire (Pegu 1538, delta 1538-39, Martaban 1541, Lan Na vassal tint from 1558), ayutthaya-kingdom (contest 1451-1474 and occupation of Chiang Mai 1452 with Lan Na; vassal over Sukhothai 1349/1378-1438 and its 1438 gain), lan-xang (gains of 1353/1363 from Lan Na and Sukhothai), northern-song / yuan-dynasty / mongol-empire / ming-dynasty (see notes), ava-kingdom (1385-1424 contest, 1415 occupation).
